hero.title: Small-group tours across all of Nepal — one price, everything arranged.
hero.subtitle: Transport, stays and meals are all in the price. Local guides, six to seven people per jeep, and the only thing you carry is a daypack.

packages.title: Pick your trip
packages.subtitle: Every trip lists exactly what you pay, where you go and what's included. No hidden costs at the trailhead.

pkg.privateBody: {reserve}. Call us to reserve a private vehicle for your group.
pkg.whatsappPrefill: Hi, I'd like to book the {name}.
pkg.seatsNote: Seats are on a {transport} basis. Call to check the next departure and hold your seat.

guides.title: Local guides
guides.body: Every trip is led by guides born on these trails — Mustang, Annapurna, Khumbu, Chitwan.

price.title: One clear price
price.body: Transport, hotels and meals are in the price you see. You budget once, then relax.

groups.title: Small groups
groups.body: Six to seven people per jeep, never busloads. Fast to move, easy to feed, good company.

map.title: Visit our office in Pokhara
map.subtitle: Drop by for a cup of tea and plan your trip with us in person.

footer.title: Ready when you are.
footer.subtitle: Call or message us on WhatsApp to hold a seat — a small deposit confirms your booking.

contact.title: Tell us about your trip
contact.subtitle: Send an inquiry about any package — or your own plan — and we'll get back to you within a day.

direct.title: The fastest way to reach us
direct.subtitle: Call or message us on WhatsApp — we usually answer right away.
direct.whatsappPrefill: Hi, I have a question about a trip.

form.name: Your name
form.contactPlaceholder: So we can reach you back
form.messagePlaceholder: Dates, group size, questions — anything helps.
form.successBody: Thank you — we'll get back to you within a day. In a hurry? Call us at <tel>{phone}</tel>.
form.errorMissing: Please fill in your name, contact and inquiry.
